caption: Figure 1: Numerically computed images, illustrating the class appearance models, learnt by a ConvNet, trained on ILSVRC-2013. Note how different aspects of class appearance are captured in a single image. Better viewed in colour.
description:
## Figure Description
This figure displays a collection of images generated by a Convolutional Neural Network (ConvNet) trained on the ILSVRC-2013 dataset. Each image represents a visual model of a specific class, capturing various aspects of the class's appearance. The images are meant to be viewed in color to fully appreciate the details.

caption: Figure 3: Weakly supervised object segmentation using ConvNets (Sect. 3.2). Left: images from the test set of ILSVRC-2013. Left-middle: the corresponding saliency maps for the top-1 predicted class. Right-middle: thresholded saliency maps: blue shows the areas used to compute the foreground colour model, cyan - background colour model, pixels shown in red are not used for colour model estimation. Right: the resulting foreground segmentation masks.
description:
This figure displays a series of images demonstrating weakly supervised object segmentation using convolutional neural networks (ConvNets). Each row shows an original image, a saliency map, a thresholded saliency map, and a resulting segmentation mask. The saliency maps highlight areas of interest, while the thresholded maps differentiate between foreground and background regions. The final masks isolate the objects of interest.

Text in figure: "ILSVRC-2013" (test set), "top-1 predicted class", "foreground colour model", "background colour model", "foreground segmentation masks".
